id: title:andyzzhao:let the read budget flag target free organizations

review.posthog_relevance: Provides tier classification metadata to HogQL and budget enforcement, enabling tier-specific query behavior and status reporting.
review.reason: Adds a helper function to classify organization subscription status and propagates this classification into HogQL execution and budget enforcement metadata. This establishes the necessary context for downstream tier-specific behavior and status reporting, though the complete enforcement and flag definition are not present in this chunk.
review.uncertainty: This chunk lacks the complete implementation of the budget enforcement and the feature flag definition, so the full systemic impact and validation are not demonstrated. The tier classification is established, but its enforcement and complete lifecycle are not visible.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the definition of the feature flag or the complete implementation of the budget enforcement, so the tier cannot be established. The score is withheld.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function _organization_plan to classify an organization as free, paid, or unknown based on subscription status.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows downstream enforcement and flag evaluation to distinguish between free and paid organization tiers.

observations.behavior: Passes the organization_plan classification into HogQL query execution and budget enforcement properties.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the tier available to HogQL and budget enforcement, potentially allowing tier-specific behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds organization_plan to the metadata returned by the budget enforcement status.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows downstream consumers of the status to know the tier of the organization.
